summary: Layer 1B expansion for the AI data-center power/grid chokepoint found one emerging reference supplier and three underfollowed discovery names. The strongest direct equipment signal is Powell Industries in medium-voltage switchgear and power-control systems. The underfollowed lane is concentrated in construction/EPC and grid-connection execution: MYR Group for transmission/substation work tied to data-center clusters, Primoris for behind-the-meter gas/microgrid, power delivery and utility infrastructure, and Modine for thermal capacity reserved by hyperscale data-center customers. This is research universe expansion only, not a buy/sell recommendation.
